svg.text: Smoke Rescue: system architecture
Robots, agents and the commander get no map, outline, entry pose or sectors. Only the evaluator reads ground truth.
Unity 6 HDRP simulation
Sensors, per robot, seeded
RGB-D 640x480 at 15 Hz, depth noise model
Thermal 320x256 (LWIR, saturates 650 C)
Planar LiDAR 720 beams 10 Hz; smoke drops pulses
IMU 200 Hz, leg odometry, thermocouple 10 Hz
Burning house (config/floorplan.json)
FireSim: spread on 0.25 m cells, heat, gas layer
Fluid smoke (stable fluids, two layers)
Water absorbs heat; wet fuel resists reignition
Recorder (RecordingSession)
Steps world, sensors, brains and agents on sim time
Writes recordings, brain maps, decisions and agent
traces; truth goes only to oracle/
Checkpoints every 30 sim s
RadioModel
Lossy, range-limited radio: robots and the post
Robot body (RobotActions)
Quadruped legs, 3-joint arm, torch, 12 L nozzle
open_door, clear_debris, spray_water,
extract_survivor: sled towed to a way out
Robot brain (C#, 60 Hz), one per robot
Mapping and localisation
Occupancy grid from LiDAR and depth, LiDAR open ground
Gyro heading plus 5 % of each scan-match turn
Live 3D top heights from the agent service TSDF
Indoor rule (own evidence only)
Ceiling seen overhead, ceiling sight lines,
or walled in on its own map in most directions
Search
Floor counts as searched only when seen within 4 m;
frontier claims shared; A* with wall and fire clearance
Heat and safety reflexes
Keep a way out: fire near the route home, leave
Heat building (30 C, or 8.3 C/min): no agent override;
cut off: emergency exit past the fire, never through it
Retreat, heat budget, re-entry when cool
Distributed context
Radio v4: map layers, claims, confirmations,
carried-out people, LiDAR keyframes
FrameLink: fingerprint shortlist, scan-match check,
two agreeing matches 1 m apart before frames link;
partner data applies only after a link
Agent layer (Python, FastAPI :8080)
Robot agent x2 (GPT, tool use)
Woken by brain events or every 20 s. Context: its
own-frame pose, offered frontiers, LiDAR summary,
radio inbox. Chooses where to search, decides if a
warm shape is a person, orders actions
OpenCV 5 perception tools (own frames)
scan_thermal, inspect_candidate, check_indoors,
YOLO11m person detector via cv2.dnn,
assess_visibility, track_fire_spread, measure_opening;
each result gets an evidence id
Guardrails in code
Actions must cite a matching OpenCV result;
confirm only within 4 m, never a person this robot
already carried out; invented frontier ids refused
Incident commander
Hears radio reports, relays them, approves risky
actions; no map, area or coordinates
Services
Live 3D map: OpenCV 5 HashTSDF per robot (/map3d)
Place recognition: ORB + 3D RANSAC (/place)
Trace: perception id -> tool call -> action
own sensors only
speed, turn, torch
radio packets
events + context
orders
refusals go back
agent actions: door, debris, water, lift (RobotActions, after the guardrails)
recordings + oracle/
Evaluation (reads hidden truth; robots never do)
oracle/ in every recording
True poses, survivors, fire events, collisions, house
point cloud, heat exposure per robot. Written by the
SmokeRescue.Oracle assembly; assembly definitions and
a pytest keep robot code away from it
Scoring and replay
nav_eval: pose error, map precision and recall, indoor
layer outside the building, stalls, link error;
compare_runs: people found, false, carried out,
searched floor, heat exposure, agent orders;
showcase.py: video from the robots’ own views
AWS (owned by Vishnu)
deploy/aws
CloudFormation: agent + OpenCV API on Fargate ARM64,
S3 + CloudFront results site, Batch job for the
OpenCV 5 SLAM container, budget alarms. No Open3D
left in the pipeline, so it runs on ARM64
